verified_facts.text: The hotel is near Puerta del Sol, the Royal Palace and Plaza Mayor.
verified_facts.excerpt: Situated near iconic landmarks such as Puerta del Sol, the Royal Palace, and Plaza Mayor

verified_facts.text: The hotel is close to the Art Walk, a UNESCO World Heritage site known as The Landscape of Light, home to El Prado, the Thyssen-Bornemisza and the Reina Sofia museums.
verified_facts.excerpt: stroll in the renowned Art Walk, included in the UNESCO World Heritage List as The Landscape of Light, where you will find some of the best art museums in the world: El Prado, the Thyssen-Bornemisza and the Reina Sofia

verified_facts.text: Most of the rooms look out onto Plaza de Canalejas.
verified_facts.excerpt: most of the rooms look out onto Plaza de Canalejas

verified_facts.text: The building preserves its original 19th-century wrought iron columns.
verified_facts.excerpt: preserving the authentic and historic character of features like the 19th century wrought iron columns

verified_facts.text: The historic Perfumeria Alvarez Gomez once occupied the building, and the hotel's dining concept takes its name from it.
verified_facts.excerpt: The concept takes its name from the historic Perfumería Álvarez Gómez that once occupied this building

verified_facts.text: The interiors are by Rockwell Group.
verified_facts.excerpt: the interiors by Rockwell Group

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites are designed with natural materials and neutral, calming colors.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed with natural materials and neutral, calming colors

verified_facts.text: Most rooms have balconies.
verified_facts.excerpt: Most of our rooms include balconies that will bring you closer to the vibrant city life.

verified_facts.text: Suites on the upper floors have large terraces with views of the city center below.
verified_facts.excerpt: Those staying in a suite on the upper floors can enjoy large, one-of-a-kind terraces with striking views of the city center below.

verified_facts.text: The Suite Canalejas has a huge terrace with sunbeds and 180-degree views.
verified_facts.excerpt: invites you to enjoy the ¨dolce far niente¨ at the huge terrace with sunbeds, amazing 180o views

verified_facts.text: The Canalejas Suite has a sunlit dining room and a spacious lounge separated from the master bedroom.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Canalejas Suite offers a sunlit dining room and a spacious lounge separated from the master bedroom for ultimate privacy.

verified_facts.text: Guests can do in-room wellness with yoga mats and video workouts.
verified_facts.excerpt: With yoga mats and video workouts that can be enjoyed in the privacy of their room

verified_facts.text: The rooms are pet-friendly and full of natural light.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pet-friendly and full of natural light

verified_facts.text: The JW Garden has a vertical kitchen garden of signature herbs that inspires the chefs and cocktail designers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our signature herbs are present in a vertical kitchen garden, where our chefs and cocktail designers come to find inspiration to draw the customized menus.

verified_facts.text: Elysium Luxury Wellness is the hotel's private spa space.
verified_facts.excerpt: Elysium Luxury Wellness is a private space to relax and reconnect with yourself.

verified_facts.text: The spa offers massages, facials and eye treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Eye Treatment

Facials

Massages

verified_facts.text: The spa has three treatment rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Its three rooms are more than enough.

verified_facts.text: The fitness centre has an industrial-chic style with exposed brick walls.
verified_facts.excerpt: the fitness centre has an industrial-chic style with exposed brick walls

verified_facts.text: The hotel, ALQVIMIA and the Museo Nacional Thyssen-Bornemisza offer a sensory journey through art and aromatherapy themed on the four seasons.
verified_facts.excerpt: JW Marriott Madrid Hotel, ALQVIMIA and the Museo Nacional Thyssen-Bornemisza join together on a sensory journey through art and aromatherapy, under the inspiring theme of the four seasons.

verified_facts.text: Guests can join a meditation with Tibetan bowls in the JW Garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests can gather at the JW Garden to get ready for the 12.15h meditation with Tibetan bowls

verified_facts.text: Botanicos Alvarez combines La Botica, a social lobby bar, and Sala de Mezclas, a full-service restaurant.
verified_facts.excerpt: Botánicos Álvarez brings together La Botica, a social lobby bar; and Sala de Mezclas, a full-service restaurant.

verified_facts.text: La Botica's cocktail programme was developed with Amarguería and mixologist Alberto Villarroel, inspired by the historic perfumery.
verified_facts.excerpt: The cocktail programme, developed in collaboration with Amarguería and mixologist Alberto Villarroel, revisits the classics through a sensory lens inspired by the historic Perfumería Álvarez Gómez

verified_facts.text: Adolfo Suarez Madrid-Barajas Airport is about 15.5 km from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: MAD is located approximately 15.5 KM from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: Parking is off-site valet parking.
verified_facts.excerpt: Off-site valet parking is available at JW Marriott Hotel Madrid.
